module_summary: 4-entry, 4-bit LIFO stack: a down-counting stack pointer indexes a small register array for push/pop selected by RW, deriving FULL/EMPTY flags from the pointer.

anchors.name: stack_mem
anchors.why: 4x4-bit stack array written on push, read and cleared on pop.

anchors.name: SP
anchors.why: Stack pointer indexing stack_mem; decremented on push, incremented on pop, sets FULL/EMPTY.

anchors.name: FULL
anchors.why: Full flag (SP==0) blocking pushes; output status.

anchors.name: EMPTY
anchors.why: Empty flag (SP[2]) blocking pops; output status.

anchors.name: dataOut
anchors.why: Registered popped data read from stack_mem[SP].

anchors.name: EN
anchors.why: Global enable gating all updates including reset.

groups.name: stack_storage
groups.description: Stack register array with push data in and registered pop data out.

groups.name: stack_control
groups.description: Stack pointer, push/pop decision and full/empty flags.
